sentences.text: Magda Chambriard, born in 1957, became CEO of Petroleo Brasileiro SA in May 2024 as only the second woman to lead the company and its sixth chief executive in five years, a reflection of the political volatility surrounding the firm.

sentences.quote: Civil Engineering degree from UFRJ (1979); Master's in Chemical Engineering (1989). Started her career at Petrobras in 1980 in oil production/reservoir engineering - spent 22 years there. From 2012-2016
sentences.text: A civil engineering graduate of UFRJ (1979) with a master's in chemical engineering (1989), she spent 22 years at Petrobras from 1980 in oil production and reservoir engineering, then served as Director-General of Brazil's oil regulator, the ANP, from 2012 to 2016, later working as an energy consultant and joining President Lula's transition team after the 2022 election.
Her contract runs through April 2027, and her plan centers on aggressive pre-salt production growth, reviving refineries and fertilizer plants, Amazon frontier drilling and net-zero carbon by 2050.

sentences.text: Petrobras's chief executive has publicly ruled out taking a larger stake in Braskem while debt talks are under way, according to a Bloomberg report dated 24 September 2026.
Separately, on 21 September 2026 Seeking Alpha reported that the company's board backed a new diesel subsidy program, with fuel payments reaching $1.9 billion.
Together, the headlines point to leadership decisions being taken at both the CEO and board level on holdings and fuel pricing policy.
